title: V-8 ENGINE 454 C.I.D. 3 X 2- CARBURETOR LINKAGE
summary: 454 3x2 (triple two-barrel, tri-power) option LJ2, canceled before production: throttle linkage between the center and front/rear carburetors, throttle cable bracket and return spring. Rods are retained at the carburetor levers by clips; the cable bracket sits on a carburetor attaching stud under the carb nut, and the cable is held to it by a production clamp and screw.

parts.name: ROD-CTR TO RR
parts.name_expanded: Throttle rod, center to rear carburetor

parts.name: ROD-CTR TO FRT
parts.name_expanded: Throttle rod, center to front carburetor

fastening.note: View A: clip [4] retains the end of rod [3] in the lever hole.
View C: clip [1] retains the end of rod [2] in the lever hole.
View B: bracket [6] goes over a carburetor attaching stud and is held by the carb attaching nut (production part, no callout).
View B: cable [5] is held to the bracket end by a production clamp and production screw (no callouts); cable end connects to the carb lever.
View B: return spring [7] hooks between the bracket and the carburetor throttle lever.
